detail: Defiance's 2026-27 roster page has no players yet. Until it does, 2027 status here goes by class: seniors count as gone.

Released Oct 28, 2026: 50 games, 28 of them marked as conference games on the schedule page, plus the WHAC Tournament May 5-9. The release stars the Apr 13 home doubleheader with Great Lakes Christian and not the Cornerstone series; the schedule page does the reverse.
Shane Gardner, Ben Babcock, Jacob Hild and Bobby Stearns are on the staff page, the same four as the 2026 season.
No commit list was checked for Defiance.
